interface.title: calypso: a parameter-conditioned stochastic timeseries emulator (Streamlit demo)
interface.field: Astrophysics: circumbinary accretion onto massive black hole binaries and their time-domain observability with LSST
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring a trained surrogate model and planning observations (forward-modelling synthetic light curves and judging whether they could be detected)
interface.what_it_is_for: Set binary eccentricity, mass ratio, mass, separation, redshift, Eddington fraction and LSST band, then draw stochastic synthetic accretion light curves (total, primary, secondary) in AB magnitudes against the LSST single-visit depth, with optional individual draws and a mean ± 1σ envelope.

data.note: The app downloads its trained PCA/Gaussian emulator artifacts on first call. In this run that took about 4 minutes, with 'Loading calypso emulator...' on screen (screens/005.webp). While waiting, the explorer opened the main menu (Rerun, Clear cache, theme; screens/013.webp), reloaded on http://localhost:8501/ (screens/016.webp), pressed Stop (screens/021.webp) and pressed R to rerun (screens/023.webp). The sidebar and plots then appeared (screens/026.webp, screens/028.webp). These were sandbox workarounds, not steps a user needs. On the replay, with the artifacts already present, the sidebar and plots rendered within seconds. Nothing is uploaded.

features.specific: e_b and q_b sliders drive calypso sampling; the top panel shows M_b magnitude in the chosen band and the lower panel M1 and M2, with the title echoing e_b and q_b

features.name: Resample with uncertainty-mode toggle
features.general: Draw a fresh random realisation set at fixed inputs, and optionally add model (epistemic) uncertainty on top of intrinsic scatter. The model uncertainty grows with distance from the training points.
features.specific: The Epistemic uncertainty checkbox recomputes immediately with the same seed. Resample redraws with a new seed. Epistemic variance is about zero at training-grid points such as (e_b=0, q_b=0.1), so the toggle has no visible effect there. The checkbox starts checked, although the method text says it is disabled by default.
steps: Set e_b and q_b away from a training-grid point
Raise Samples for stats so the envelope width is stable
Toggle Epistemic uncertainty and compare the envelope width (same seed)
Press Resample to draw a new set with a new seed
serves_tasks: Draw a fresh random set at the same parameters
Check whether model-uncertainty inflation changes the spread at a training-grid point

features.specific: LSST band selectbox (u, g, r, i, z, y); the pink 'LSST lim (sv)' region moves with the band (about 23.9 mag in u) and marks undetectable magnitudes

features.name: Physical-units scaling to observed magnitudes and years
features.general: Convert a dimensionless model signal into observed magnitudes and a time axis in years by setting the system's physical mass and size. Some mass and size combinations are physically invalid.
features.specific: The log10(M_b/Msun) and log10(a_b/pc) sliders set the AB magnitudes and the time axis (e.g. t0 + 9367.8 yr at log M_b=10, log a_b=0). log M_b=10 with log a_b=-3 raises 'Roche radius is smaller than minimum disk radius'. Redshift z and Eddington fraction f_Edd sliders are also present but were not tried.
steps: Set log10(a_b/pc), raising it with mass if the Roche-radius error appears
Read the magnitude scale and the time axis in years
